name: banner-hard
prompt: Create one premium polished mobile game UI asset: a blank horizontal orange capsule banner, transparent RGBA background. Reference image is a rough PROGRAM MOCKUP: use only its capsule proportion, orange palette and overall game style, do not include any other items. Final capsule width:height is exactly 840:220 (3.818:1); horizontal, NOT tilted, perfectly semicircular left and right ends, symmetric. Front surface top bright warm orange #FFB547 fading vertically to orange-red #FF6A3D at bottom. Visible thick soft bevel/extrusion along bottom in deep orange-red #D2452A. A broad soft white translucent upper highlight gives gentle rounded light-3D volume; upper-right lighting. A single fine white dashed stitched seam runs inset along the full capsule outline, like a carefully sewn plush fabric rim. A sparse extremely faint white outlined small bubble-circle pattern printed inside, low contrast, especially keep the center quiet for separate text. Smooth premium plush-cloth surface with only subtle microtexture, not shaggy fur or grainy rough noise. Carefully refined curves, rounded edges, clean soft studio shading, rich bright colors. ONLY THE BLANK CAPSULE. No text or letters at all, no badge, face, stars, lightning, flare, background, surrounding glow or detached shadow. Center in a wide transparent canvas, make the complete banner as large as possible without cropping its edges. No white rectangular background or white outer border.
